map.输入室内甲醛、TVOC、苯等污染物浓度，按GB/T 18883标准判定室内空气质: Enter indoor formaldehyde, TVOC, benzene and other pollutant concentrations and judge indoor air quality against the GB/T 18883 standard

map.办公室通风评估：多次采样取均值后判定，结合通风时长给出改善建议（通风、活性炭、绿: Office ventilation assessment: average multiple samples and judge, then give improvement advice based on ventilation duration (ventilation, activated carbon, plants, professional remediation).

map.限值按哪个标准？: Which standard do the limits come from?
map.本工具默认 GB/T 18883（人居室内），与 GB 50325（验收）限值不: This tool defaults to GB/T 18883 (indoor residential), whose limits differ from GB 50325 (acceptance) — the latter is stricter; distinguish them as needed.
map.采样前密闭时长、温度、湿度、通风历史都会显著影响结果，建议按标准条件采样。: Sealed time before sampling, temperature, humidity and ventilation history all significantly affect the result, so sample under standard conditions.
map.超标了怎么处理？: What to do about an exceedance?
map.加强通风、控制污染源，必要时专业治理并复测；本工具仅作判定参考，不代表 CMA: Improve ventilation, control the source, and use professional remediation plus retesting if needed; this tool is a judgement reference only and is not a CMA test report.
